description: §6.7.7 explicit deps OVERRIDE inference (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"). The body reads @userId but the author lists only deps=[@ver]. Changing @userId to 2 must NOT re-execute the fetch: @userData stays user 1 ("a"). Pre-S444 the reader returned [] for the parsed deps attribute, so the body fell back to INFERRED deps [@userId] and re-fetched user 2. Twin of request-deps-explicit-listed-refire-rt.
rationale: §6.7.7 Syntax: "The `deps` attribute is optional. When absent, the compiler infers reactive dependencies from `@variable` reads within the fetch expression. When present, `deps` overrides inference." g-request-deps-attr-ignored-both-forms (S444).
